finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14 and took prod down.**

First error at [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). Cache fell back to direct store reads. The store buckled under the miss storm. Every process logged 5000ms `TimeoutError`. Queue depth climbed 52 to 568. All 13 reconnects hit `ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. `worker-2` died of heap exhaustion at 02:31:44. Supervisor killed `api` 8 seconds later.

These logs are dated 2026-07-04, not last night.

Next: find why Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 refused every connect.
